brand.splashSub: The Walmart endcap where every product opens the game.

product.label: Activated Cap
product.description: Structured six-panel cap with an embroidered mark and a woven NFC label under the brim. One tap opens the drop: no app, no login wall.

unlock.title: Holo Cap
unlock.sub: Matching UGC accessory · one claim per cap

product.trigger: Woven NFC label + QR hang tag

product.label: Collector Plush
product.description: A 28 cm plush of the property's hero avatar with an NFC chip sewn into the tush tag. The physical friend unlocks its digital twin.
product.trigger: NFC chip in the tush tag

product.label: Activated Keychain
product.description: Chunky vinyl charm with an embedded NFC chip, the same format as the EVADE pilot keychain: an exclusive mini-game plus an in-game UGC item (subject to final approval).

product.label: Activated Desk Mat
product.description: XL desk mat printed with property key art. The QR is hidden inside the artwork, so the print itself is the trigger.

product.label: Boxed Collectible
product.description: Window-box collectible figure with a QR printed inside the box. Scanning reveals which avatar skin came in this box.

unlock.title: Figure skin reveal
unlock.sub: Series-1 skin matched to the figure

product.label: Activated Tee
product.description: Heavyweight tee with a printed QR on the inner hem and an NFC care label. The pilot's second SKU format.

product.label: Activated Hoodie
product.description: Midweight pullover with a neon cuff stripe and an NFC label at the hem. Owning the physical hoodie unlocks the same drop for your avatar.

tour.title: Stop them in the aisle
tour.body: A 3.84 m Walmart endcap built from modular lightbox towers, a channel-letter header and a 12-tile video wall. It reads from the end of the aisle, and every surface either sells or activates.

tour.title: Tell the property's story
tour.body: The same fixture re-skins for any Roblox-native IP. Here it's Skyrift Racers, a sample property: its key art on the towers and the hero screen, its colours in the LED channels. Same hardware.

tour.title: Merchandise that extends the IP
tour.body: A cap, collector plush, keychains, a desk mat, boxed collectibles, a tee and a hoodie, each with an NFC tag or a QR. Tap any product and it comes off the shelf.

tour.title: Tap, play, unlock
tour.body: A tap on any product opens the experience in the browser. No app: a 12-second drop, a reveal, then a UGC reward redeemed inside the creator's Roblox experience.

tour.title: Back to Roblox, and measured
tour.body: Unique activations, repeat interactions, engagement time and outbound traffic to Roblox, reported by location, property and creative treatment. This is the data behind the 90-day program review.

tour.title: Built modular
tour.body: Six modules bolt together on site: two lightbox towers, the header, the video wall, the merch bay and the plinth, plus a freestanding digital totem. When the featured property changes, you swap graphics, not fixtures.
